item.title: Nine deaths tied to Trump’s immigration enforcement operations in US
item.description: Fatal shooting in Biddeford, Maine, is latest in at least nine deaths linked to US president's immigration crackdown.

item.title: US, Iran exchange attacks around Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Washington and Tehran both claim to be in control of the strategic waterway as fighting escalates.

item.title: Lindsey Graham’s legacy: Israel advocate, Trump ally, Iran war supporter
item.description: Late US senator backed invasion of Iraq, war on Iran and approach of 'more for Israel' as he became a Trump confidant.

item.title: US strikes Iranian ship with drone boats in first-of-its-kind attack
item.description: US CENTCOM has published a video it says shows three Corsair unmanned surface vessels striking an Iranian ship facility

item.title: Kyiv attacked after Ukraine launches coalition to tackle Russia missiles
item.description: Russia has escalated attacks in recent weeks, taking advantage of Ukraine’s critical shortage of air defences.

item.title: Iran military warns US against Strait of Hormuz ‘interference’
item.description: Iran's military has warned it will not allow the United States to ‘interfere’ in the management of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Artist sews names of Gaza children killed by Israel into gown
item.description: Welsh artist Diana Williams stitched the names of 300 babies killed by Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza into a gown.

item.title: US keeping the Strait of Hormuz open is ‘a massive force problem’
item.description: Former NATO analyst says Trump's push for a naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz would mean a huge military operation.

item.title: UK designates IRGC as terrorist organisation
item.description: The UK government has designated Iran’s Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) as a terrorist organisation under new powers.

item.title: Trump reinstates Iran port blockade and vows 20% charge on cargo passing through Hormuz
item.description: The US military later said it had started the third consecutive night of strikes on Iran.
